title: TrustLens Detection Result (DET-001 design contract)
description: Phase 3 DET-001. The canonical output contract for ONE TrustLens evaluation: what TrustLens concluded, how strongly, why, and under exactly which pinned knowledge — such that the decision is fully reproducible and fully explainable. DESIGN CONTRACT: it fixes the shape the deterministic engine (a later phase) must produce; the engine is not built here. The four decision quantities are SEPARATE fields (severity, risk_level, detection_confidence, matched_evidence_strength) and are NEVER collapsed into one number or a probability (CONF-001, glossary section 1). input_support_status is decided BEFORE classification, and UNSUPPORTED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE are never mapped to a benign outcome (STEP 3; UNKNOWN is not SAFE).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant of evaluation. Provenance only; not an input to any decision quantity.

language.description: Detected/declared language tags of the input.

script.description: Detected/declared script codes of the input.

input_support_status.description: STEP 3, decided FIRST. SUPPORTED: en/Latn with an evaluable observation frame. PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: supported language but some required channel missing (e.g. OCR failed). UNSUPPORTED: outside MVP language/script scope (G-08/ADR-0014) — detection is NOT attempted and the result is NEVER benign. INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: supported input, too few observations for any rule combination. ERROR: fail-closed integrity/exception state. None of these maps to LOW RISK automatically.

classification.description: STEP 4 — what TrustLens CONCLUDES from observable evidence, distinct from severity (harm if genuine). NO_SCAM_PATTERN: no composite rule fires (or all suppressed) on supported input. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: supported input, no rule combination satisfied and/or an unresolved decisive ambiguity (UNKNOWN is not SAFE). SCAM_PATTERN_SUSPECTED: a rule fired but detection_confidence is LOW. SCAM_PATTERN_DETECTED: a rule fired at detection_confidence MEDIUM/HIGH. UNSUPPORTED / ERROR mirror input_support_status.

severity.description: Highest EFFECTIVE severity among fired rules (harm IF the pattern is genuine). Ordinal, never numeric. NONE when no rule fires.

matched_evidence_strength.description: Strength of the matched evidence behind the governing rule: derived from the decisive indicators' strength, the rule's evidence verdict (SUPPORTED>PARTIAL>HEURISTIC) and whether a hard-risk override is active. Feeds risk_level; distinct from detection_confidence (glossary section 1).

risk_level.description: Computed exposure for THIS submission = ordinal lookup of (severity x matched_evidence_strength) per ADR-0006's fixed matrix. Bounded, decomposable, reproducible, user-visible as a band. NOT a probability and NOT a percentage. Independent of detection_confidence, which is reported alongside and never averaged in.

detection_confidence.description: STEP 9 — how much TrustLens trusts its own analysis of THIS submission: completeness of required observations, extraction confidence of decisive indicators, corroboration across INDEPENDENT evidence classes, evidence verdict, ambiguity, benign context. Categorical. NOT a calibrated fraud probability. NOT_APPLICABLE when no rule fires or input is UNSUPPORTED/ERROR.

provenance.description: STEP 23 — everything that affects the output, pinned. Same (observations + bundle + engine_version + evaluation_profile) MUST yield an identical result.

bundle_content_digest.description: SHA-256 content digest of the published knowledge bundle (ADR-0004). Answers 'which knowledge executed'.

engine_version.description: Version of the deterministic detection engine (ADR-0005).

evaluation_profile.description: The tunable, pinned configuration. No hidden configuration may affect the result.

extraction_confidence_gate.description: Minimum extraction confidence for an indicator to count as OBSERVED; below it the indicator is treated as UNKNOWN, not FALSE (STEP 8). MVP default MEDIUM.

risk_matrix_id.description: Identifier of the fixed severity x evidence-strength -> risk matrix (ADR-0006).

confidence_policy_id.description: Identifier of the fixed detection-confidence banding policy (ADR-0006).

component_versions.description: Pinned versions of every knowledge component consulted (rule_schema, indicator_registry, indicator_families, negative_library, taxonomy, dimensions, extraction_contracts) plus per-fired-rule rule_version echoed in rule_results.

rule_results.description: One entry per rule that MATCHED, was SUPPRESSED, or came out INDETERMINATE. NOT_MATCHED rules may be omitted for brevity but INDETERMINATE ones must be kept (they explain unresolved uncertainty).

corroboration.description: STEP 13 — corroboration measured over INDEPENDENT evidence classes/families, NOT rule count. Five rules off one URL keyword corroborate weakly; five independent observations corroborate strongly.

explanation.description: STEP 15 — structured first. Every field is derived from runtime facts + the fired rules' stored explanation/evidence; no unsupported factual claim may appear (explanation-provenance constraint).

what.description: What TrustLens detected, in plain language.

supporting_observations.description: The exact observations/spans that supported the finding.

suppressors_considered.description: Each suppressor and whether it applied or was blocked by an override, and why.

evidence_citations.description: Official citations behind the fired rules — issuing body, verification status, evidence class, and the stored quote. The ONLY facts the narrative may assert.

detection_confidence_reason.description: Operational meaning of the confidence band for this decision (STEP 9).

recommended_actions.description: STEP 16 — controlled vocabulary; each action MUST trace to a fired rule / active override / matched family. Never emitted beyond the evidence.

justified_by.description: Rule id / override id / family id that supports this action.

limitations.description: STEP 22 — e.g. synthetic-only validation, no accuracy claim (G-09), capped PARTIAL evidence.

ambiguities.description: Decisive observations that were AMBIGUOUS, e.g. payment direction unresolved (STEP 14/17).

degraded.description: True if a per-rule error occurred but evaluation continued; caps confidence and routes to review (STEP 25).

errors.description: Fail-closed diagnostics when input_support_status=ERROR or degraded=true.
